Well, the Blake decision, as you know, this was a court decision that forced the legislature to rethink the situation. My belief is that when it comes to addiction, we ought to focus on two things. I do believe I'm not in favor of totally removing any criminal sanction because I think there can be served as an inspiration of people to get into treatment.
